parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: A rectangular switch button made of ABS plastic, part of a wall switch panel.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main actuator for turning electrical circuits on or off.
parts.Movement_description: It moves back and forth with a small displacement when pressed, returning to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: A secondary switch button made of ABS plastic, identical in structure to the first switch.
parts.Functional_description: It controls a separate electrical circuit, allowing independent operation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves in a similar push-button manner, toggling between on and off states.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: A third switch button made of ABS plastic, part of the same control panel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an additional control point for another electrical load or device.
parts.Movement_description: It operates through a press-and-release motion, similar to the other switches.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main housing or faceplate of the wall switch panel, made of durable polycarbonate.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support for the switches and electrical sockets, and mounts to the wall.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall, serving as the stable base for the moving switch components.
